bias.en: Downtrend · broke $163, lowest close since April
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $163，收盘创 4月以来新低

read.en: Arm fell 14.1% on Nov 20 to $152.20, its lowest close since Apr 10, trading $150.38–170.65 on heavy volume (1.81x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($174.1), 10-day ($183.2), 30-day ($206.8) and 100-day ($253.4), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($234.5). MACD crossed back below its signal on Nov 20, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($192.96), and RSI is 31.8.
read.zh: Arm 11月20日下跌 14.1%，收于 $152.20，为 4月10日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $150.38–170.65，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.81 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$174.1）、10 日（$183.2）、30 日（$206.8）和 100 日均线（$253.4）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$234.5）。MACD 于 11月20日重新下穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$192.96），RSI 为 31.8。

read.en: The drop broke both written supports, $173–175 (Nov 17 low) and $163–167 (Nov 5 low and close), now resistance. Resistance is $153–159 (Apr 1 high, 2025 swing points), then $163–165 and $173–174 (5-day). Support is $149–150.4 (Nov 20 low, Apr 10 close), then $145.4–146.3 (2025 lows) and $140. A close above $159 would target $163–165; below $149, $145–146.
